name: JW Marriott New Orleans
insider_take: This sophisticated French Quarter gem sits on the historic Canal Street, where streetcars still clang past century-old facades and jazz spills from every doorway.
whats_special: The JW Marriott New Orleans occupies a prime location at the gateway to the French Quarter, housed in a beautifully restored historic building. The hotel features original architectural details like soaring ceilings and ornate moldings, while the rooftop pool offers stunning views of the Mississippi River and French Quarter rooftops. You're steps away from world-famous Bourbon Street and the vibrant arts scene of Royal Street.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Canal Street to watch the historic streetcars roll by, or request a higher floor for glimpses of the mighty Mississippi River curving around the Crescent City.
dont_miss: Take the Canal Street streetcar to the Garden District's antebellum mansions, catch live jazz at preservation Hall (3 blocks away), and explore the French Market's local crafts and beignets at the original Café du Monde, all within a 10-minute walk from your door.
pros: Prime French Quarter location with easy access to iconic attractions
Luxury amenities and upscale accommodations with modern design
High-end dining options and premium hotel services
Marriott Bonvoy elite benefits and Luminous Program perks
cons: French Quarter location can be bustling and crowded
